string.text: Hey, no shooting in camp. You won't get a second warning.
Word is Sidorovich got hold of something unusual. It won't sit there long.
They say Barman has a nice piece in. Not cheap, of course.
Pakhom out in the swamps took some good stuff off someone. First come, first served.
The scientists at Yantar bought something interesting. Sometimes they sell things on.
That's it, guys. I'm done. Heading home through Cordon, and you won't hear from me again.
Debts paid, pack packed. I'm leaving through Cordon, for good. Don't think badly of me.
My daughter starts school this year, and I'm still out here. Enough. I'm going home.
Never thought I'd say it, but I'm leaving. I've got enough money, and my legs still work. So I'm going while they do.
Guys, who wants my sleeping bag? Kidding, you can't have it. People sleep on the mainland too. I'm off.
Funny thing. All that time dreaming of getting out, and now I'm packed I feel sick about it. Going anyway.
Going home. If I don't make it to Cordon, I guess I shouldn't have said that out loud.
That's it, boys, my last trip is the way out. I'm not leaving you my bolts, I need them.
They say whoever leaves comes back. We'll see about that. I'm off.
Everyone who sat at a fire with me, thanks. Everyone who shot at me, you too, you missed. I'm leaving the Zone.
That's it, boys. Haul's sold, I'm going home.
About time. Just make it there, or it'll be a shame.
I will. I'm careful now. I've got something to lose.
I'm leaving the Zone, guys. Made my money, and that's enough.
Made his money, he says... Wish I could. Well, have a drink for me out there.
I will, $name. First one's yours.
That's it, I'm going home. You won't see me again.
Hey, $name, leave the sleeping bag. You'll be back anyway.
Don't hold your breath.
I'm packed and going home. For good.
Everyone says that. Six months from now you'll be back at the fire, telling us how boring it was out there.
Guys, I'm leaving. Through Cordon and home.
The Zone doesn't let go that easily. I left once myself. And here I sit.
You're you. I've got people waiting at home.
Anyone know if the soldiers on Cordon are in a bad mood today? I'm getting out of the Zone.
They always are. Go at night and keep your money handy. Good luck.
Got it. Thanks, $name.
Farewell, guys. I'm off to the mainland.
And do what there? No artefacts, no mutants. Just neighbors.
At least neighbors don't bite.
I'm leaving. Don't think badly of me.
I envy you, $name. Honestly. I'd go too, but it never quite happens.
Anyone remember a guy called $name? Got out through Cordon. Alive, with money. It does happen.
So there are lucky people after all. $name got out of the Zone. They say the soldiers didn't even search him.
Word from Cordon: $name made it past the perimeter. At least it worked for someone.
$name actually made it out. Whoever bet he wouldn't, pay up.
Remember that guy saying his goodbyes here, $name? He made it. Past the perimeter already.
One less at the fire: $name is out of the Zone. Let's drink to that.
Anyone remember a guy called $name? He was going home. He didn't make it.
$name never got to Cordon. Nobody knows what happened.
Remember that guy saying his goodbyes here, $name? No need to wait for a postcard.
For those who said goodbye: $name didn't make it. That's how it goes.
He had the money, and he had a home. $name didn't make it.
New face at the rookie camp on Cordon. Holds his detector like an icon.
A rookie turned up on Cordon. Asking for the easiest road to the center of the Zone. We only held back the laughing out of pity.
Another one at the rookie camp. Clean suit, big eyes. Neither will last.
The new guy on Cordon is counting his bolts. Counted them three times. He might do all right.
Fresh blood at the rookie camp. He's already asked if tushkanos bite. They bite, kid.
We have gas, $name brought it. No more needed for now.
The generator's running. $name brought a canister.
Gas is sorted. $name made it, no need to bring any.
The Bar has gas, $name brought it. No more needed for now.
Power's back at the Bar. $name brought a canister.
Gas is sorted. $name made it, no need to bring any.
$name went for gas and didn't come back.
Still no gas. $name isn't answering.
Anyone know where $name is? Went for gas. Looks like he won't show.
$name came by and took what he was owed for that thing. All fair.
$name and I are square: the thing is dead, and he took what's his.
That business with the creature is closed. $name came for his reward and got it.
$name was here. Told me how it went and took what I owed. He keeps his word, and so do I.
$name was going to collect a reward. Didn't make it.
Anyone know a guy called $name? Killed that thing and never came for the money.
They waited for him to collect, but no $name. Looks like he won't come.
People died out there, $where. Some are already going to see what happened.
Some of ours went to check what happened $where. Somebody got killed there.
They say something's wrong $where: a few men didn't come back. Others went after them.
If anyone's close, $where - there were bodies. A group is going to look into it.
Lost somebody again, $where. People are going to look. Not everyone's happy about it.
Saw a group of ours moving. Should be $where by now. After loot, no doubt.
Some guys packed up and moved out. Said they'd be $where.
A group of stalkers drifted off, $where. Maybe they know something.
A Duty patrol went past. They'll be $where soon, by the look of it.
Duty has sent people, expected $where. So there'll be order there soon. Or shooting.
A Duty group moved out, $where. Serious faces.
Freedom guys packed up and went, $where. Singing, as a matter of fact.
A Freedom group passed through, $where. Wouldn't say what the hurry was.
Freedom is out and about again, now $where. Could have offered a drink.
Scientists with an escort came out, $where. Measuring something, as always.
The ecologists are off somewhere, $where. So their instruments showed something.
Saw mercs on the move $where. Moving quietly. Stay out of their way.
A group of mercs went by, $where. I lay low and waited. I suggest you do the same.
Careful: mercs moved out, $where. Better not to know who hired them.
Bandits went by in a group, $where. Good thing they didn't see me.
Saw bandits on the move $where. Go around if you have anything to lose.
A pack of thugs is on the move, $where. If you're headed there, keep your gun handy.
They say the Agroprom papers reached the right people. Expect things to start moving.
The army is turning Agroprom upside down. Someone took something from them, something serious.
Someone brought Barkeep something from Agroprom. I didn't see it, but it's all they talk about at the Bar.
Something changed in Dark Valley. There are different people in the old spots now.
Heard about X-18? Somebody went in and came out. With documents, they say.
Camps on the Garbage and in the Valley are changing hands. Watch who you walk up to.
It's quiet at Yantar. No headache. They say something got switched off in X-16.
The scientists at Yantar are on edge. You can get through now, the question is why you'd want to.
People are drifting to Yantar. Where brains used to boil, they say you can walk now.
The Scorcher is silent. I didn't believe it myself, but it's silent.
The road north is open. First one there gets the loot.
They say you can get past the Radar now. Only nobody has come back to tell about it.
That's it, guys, the north is open. I think I'll sit here and see who comes back.
That's it, I'm sick of this. I'm going past the Scorcher. They say nobody comes back, well, I'm not planning to give talks.
I'm leaving the Warehouses and heading north. Past the Scorcher the loot is untouched. I've got a good helmet, should be enough.
Don't try to talk me out of it. I'm going past the Scorcher. Somebody has to be first.
I've got nothing to lose here, and they say it's all just lying there. I'm going to the Radar. Don't think badly of me.
$name isn't answering. There was a signal, then noise, then nothing.
Anyone know a guy called $name? Went north. Doesn't come on the net anymore.
Yesterday $name was still mumbling something on our frequency. Today, silence.
Going for gas, the station in the Gut.
I'm going for gas. The station in the Gut, then back.
I'll go to the Gut for a canister. Nobody else is going anyway.
Headed for the station in the Gut. There'll be gas if I make it.
Going for gas too. We'll see who's first.
To the Gut for a canister. Whoever gets back first gets paid.
$name, no need to hurry. The gas is already here.
$name, turn around. I got it there.
$name, I got there first. Already got paid.
$name, stand down. The generator's running.
Got it, $name. You win.
So why am I still hauling this, $name?
Lucky you, $name. Next time we'll see.
You could have said sooner, $name. I'm halfway there.
Fine, $name. Where do I go with this canister now?
Got here with the canister, and the gas is already in. Wasted trip.
Somebody beat me to it. The generator's running, and I'm still holding the canister.
Too late. They say the gas is already here, nobody says who brought it.
Never mind the gas, someone got there first. I'll hang on to the canister, it'll come in handy.

A pseudodog called $name is hunting $where. Scarred hide, bullets hardly seem to bother it.
They say a creature called $name has settled $where. It has taken people already.
$name is hunting again, $where. It's a pseudodog, only bigger than it should be.
A boar called $name is about, $where. All scars, and not afraid of people at all.
$name - that's what the guys call that boar, $where. It has gored two already.
If you see a huge boar $where, don't shoot from far off. That's $name, it only gets angrier.
A snork called $name is crawling around $where. Whoever sleeps nearby stops answering.
They say one snork $where stalks people instead of waiting. Name's $name.
$name is a snork, $where. All torn up, and faster than the others.
A bloodsucker called $name is hunting $where. Old, scarred, and it has taken people already.
$name is hunting again - a bloodsucker, $where. Better not walk there at night.
There's a bloodsucker $where that got a name: $name. Names aren't handed out for nothing.
The creature called $name is finished. Who did it, nobody knows.
They found a carcass. They say that's $name. Nobody is owning up to the kill.
No need to worry about $name anymore. Someone closed the matter.
The name $name doesn't scare anyone now. Somebody finally went and did it.
Word is: $name is done. Some loner did it, they say.
Someone deserves a drink for $name. A man turned up and put it down.

A chimera called $name is hunting $where. It has more scars than we have rounds.
They say $name is about, $where. It's a chimera, and not much gets found afterwards.
Anyone going $where, think again. There's one they call $name, and it isn't scared of groups.
A burer called $name has holed up $where. It tears guns out of your hands, and people don't walk away anymore.
$name - heard that name? A burer, $where. Only crates fly out of there, people don't.
They say an old, scarred burer sits $where. Name's $name. Better stay out of tight spots there.
A pseudogiant called $name is roaming $where. Every stomp knocks people off their feet, and bullets barely touch it.
They say $name is roaming $where. Two storeys tall, and its stomp knocks everyone nearby onto the ground.
If you see that big one $where, don't go near it. That's $name. It's slow, but the stomp will drop you, and ammo is wasted on it.
Brought Prosha a load of guts, and right at the door he says: "Get lost, sick one, I've got nothing today." I didn't come to buy! Fine, I'll wait till tomorrow.
Prosha's off again. Sitting here with a full sack of guts, waiting for morning. Hope they don't go bad.
Anyone know what's got into the Butcher? Told me where to go, says he's got no time for me today. I'll sit close by and try again tomorrow.
Anyone $where right now, keep your eyes open. It was empty there by day, and now something's walking around.
Getting dark. What sat in its hole all day is coming out in the open. If you're not in a hurry, wait it out by a fire.
Something walks $where at night now. Fresh tracks in the morning, and by day it's empty again.
Something's stirring $where. It was quiet there by day, so stay out till morning.
I saw something climb out of the ground $where at sunset. Heavy steps, and the rubble shifted on its own. Don't ask me what it was.
Something came up through a hatch $where at sunset. I didn't see legs or hands, just the air rippling. Stay clear of it.
A burrow opened $where at dusk and something walked out. Slow, dragging branches behind it. I sat tight in the bushes.
Once it got dark, something crawled out of the tunnels $where. All I saw was a blur, and I heard steps like on metal. Keep your distance.
Saw a shadow lift out from under a slab $where at sunset. It moved on its own, like someone was steering it. I won't go back near there.
When the sun went down, something rose out of the ground $where. Couldn't tell if it was an animal or worse. Better to wait out the night somewhere else.
I found $item $level. Something nasty had dug in there, so I had to shoot my way through. Got it, though.
Took down the things $level and barely walked out alive. But $item is mine now.
Almost didn't make it out $level. The beasts nearly had me, but I pulled $item out in the end.
Nothing's left $level. I cleared out everything holding the place and took $item.
Finally! $item was lying $level, with nothing but beasts around it. I had to fight for it, but the loot's mine now.
Phew, still alive. Got $item $level, and whatever was living there is gone. I'll rest up before I move on.
I've had enough of this. A creature called $name is roaming $where, and I'm getting men together. If you're in, come on.
Looking for shooters for a hunt. The job's $where, and the thing goes by $name. Whatever we cut off it, we split.
Everyone's heard of the creature called $name, and still nobody walks $where. I'm putting a group together to end it.
A group is forming. Target: $name, $where. No sense going in alone, so if you're tired of being scared, join us.
The lair $where needs clearing before it spreads. I'm putting a group together, who's with me?
Found a nest, $where. Nothing there for one man, but a group can make money. Getting people together.
So many creatures you can't get through, $where. I'm taking men to clear it out. We split the guts.
Who needs money and doesn't mind spending rounds? Got a job: a lair, $where. Already gathering.
We've gathered, moving out. Target's the creature called $name, $where. If you didn't make it, tough luck.
We're out. Tracking it $where. They call it $name, so if you run into it before we do, don't play the hero.
Enough men, enough rounds. We're going after the creature called $name. Watch for news.
Moving out. We'll be $where, on the net. If we go quiet, don't come after us.
Everyone's here, moving out. We're clearing the lair, $where. We'll be back with goods.
Moving out, the job's $where. If you didn't make it, you don't get a share.
We're out. Anyone $where right now, keep out from underfoot: the creatures are ours, and so are the guts.
Heading for the lair. We'll be $where, you'll hear it soon enough.
The creature called $name has run its last, $where. The guys are on their way back with something to sell.
Heard? It's a bit safer to walk $where now: the guys caught up with it, and the creature called $name won't touch anyone again.
If the name $name scared you, you can breathe out. The hunt paid off.
Found it and put it down. That same creature, $where, the one called $name. Worth a drink.
The lair $where has been cleared. You can walk there until new ones move in.
The guys are done, $where. No more creatures in sight, and the traders will soon be up to their necks in guts.
If you walk $where, it's quieter now. The group did a proper job and is heading home.
Hear the shooting $where? That was them clearing a lair. It's cleared.
The hunt for the creature called $name went badly. Not everyone's coming back, and it's still walking around $where.
The group ran into the creature called $name. Lost men and pulled back, and it barely noticed.
$name is still out there, $where. The hunters pulled back a man or two short. Stay away for now.
No luck. The creature called $name is alive, and there are fewer of us. If you were following them, turn back.
They didn't take the lair $where. More creatures than they thought, and fewer men now.
The guys pulled back, $where. Left someone behind. Go around that place.
The lair job went wrong, $where. Not everyone's coming back.
All that shooting, and the creatures are still sitting $where same as before. Some of ours fell there.
They went after the creature called $name and didn't come back. None of them.
The group hunting $where isn't answering. Not one of them.
Their frequency has gone quiet. They were hunting $where, after the creature called $name. A drink for them.
The creature called $name still walks, and the men who went after it are gone. That's how it goes.
They went to clear the lair $where. Nobody came back.
The group working $where isn't answering. Not one of them.
It's gone quiet, $where. The shooting didn't last, and nobody has come on the net from there since.
Don't walk $where. One group already stayed there for good.
The hunters lost the trail of the creature called $name. Wandered around $where, then went home.
The creature called $name vanished into thin air. The trail went cold $where, and the hunt's off.
It slipped away as if it knew they were coming. The guys circled around $where and gave up, and the name $name isn't going anywhere.
They searched and searched, no use. $name is out there somewhere, and the guys are going home.
The guys stood around $where, hardly fired a shot, and went home. The lair's still there.
No clearing after all. They circled around $where, didn't push their luck, and went home.
The hunt for the creature called $name is off: not enough men showed up. Everyone's great at talking.
All that shouting about getting the creature called $name, and hardly anyone made it to the meet. Stand down.
Nobody to clear the lair $where: hardly anyone came to the meet. Stand down.
They meant to go after the lair, but couldn't find the men. So nothing changes $where for now.
Prosha's just a short walk away, it'd be a sin not to drop in. Guts sold, now a canister and back.
Prosha took the guts, didn't make a face for long. Now the gas, and back.
While I was here, I sold Butcher Prosha everything I was carrying. If they pay for the canister too, it's a good day.
The creature called $name is dead, $where. Nobody's in a hurry to celebrate: it took some of theirs first.
They brought down the creature called $name. It cost them: not everyone lived to see the carcass.
They got the creature called $name, $where, and paid for it in men. You don't clink glasses over that.
You can forget the name $name. Not the ones who stayed $where, though.
The lair $where is gone. Not all of the men who cleared it walked away.
They took the lair $where. Everyone's share came out bigger than planned, and nobody's glad of it.
It's quiet now, $where. The guys got the job done, but nobody wants to talk about how it went.
Nothing left to shoot at $where. There's someone to drink to, though.
The creature called $name chased the hunters off, $where. All alive, but they ran in a way they'd rather not recall.
They went after the creature called $name, and it turned out the other way round. Everyone's fine, they'll just need clean pants.
The guys came back in one piece and white as sheets. They say don't walk $where while $name is there, and they won't look you in the eye saying it.
Nobody lost, and thank God for that. $name is still there, $where, and the hunters won't hear the end of this.
The hunters got driven off, $where. The creature called $name didn't let them all go. Stay away from there, please.
They went to kill the creature called $name, and now the ones who got away are glad of even that. Someone didn't get away.
Heard them on the net: they didn't sound like themselves. $name is still out there, $where, and some of them are gone.
If you're $where right now, get out. The creature called $name just drove off a whole group, and not all of them left.
The creature called $name broke the group apart, $where. Those who got out can't talk yet.
Good men, the ones who fell there. The creature called $name walks as it always did, and they're not coming back.
Some of them are still lying there, $where. Nobody to fetch them: the creature called $name hasn't left.
Pour one for those who went after the creature called $name and never came out. The ones who did can't hold a glass yet.
The lair $where chewed them up. Those who got out are walking apart and hardly come on the net.
They shouldn't have gone into that lair, $where. I'm sorry for the guys, and the creatures don't look any fewer.
Don't go $where for the bodies. The lair's standing as it was, and the creatures there are well fed now.
They went to make money and earned a wake. The lair $where is untouched, and the men aren't coming back.
